purpose: Normalize Internet Archive metadata into RTT grammar to determine substrate, regime, drift sensitivity, coherence, and lineage identifiers.

substrate_type.description: Structural substrate (html, pdf, image, ocr, mixed).

regime.description: Operational regime (institutional, media, scholarly, cultural, technical).

drift_sensitivity.description: Expected drift level based on substrate and regime.

coherence.description: Internal structural consistency of the object.

lineage_ids.description: Identifiers linking the object to collections, clusters, or prior versions.

procedure: Normalize fields into RTT grammar: substrate, regime, drift_sensitivity, coherence, lineage_ids.
Predict drift sensitivity based on substrate and regime.
Emit normalized metadata for WAYBACK_OPERATOR and LINEAGE_OPERATOR.
guarantees: Metadata treated as structural hints, not ground truth.
Drift sensitivity is predictive, not retrospective.
Regime classification is structural, not semantic.
Output deterministic given same IA metadata.
